title: Everyday Phrases — At the Phone Repair Shop
scene_zh: 手機維修店 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hi, is this the phone repair shop?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】📱 實用手機維修店必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Phone Repair Shop
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用手機維修店情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從描述摔壞的螢幕、詢問檢測報價與保固配件，到等待備份資料、取機驗機付款售後，全程用得到的英文短句都有。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the Phone Repair Shop phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). From describing a cracked screen and asking for a quote, warranty and parts, to waiting, backing up data, and paying at pickup. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the phone repair shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, ɪz ðɪs ðə foʊn rɪˈpɛr ʃɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問這裡是修手機的店嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, what seems to be the problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌt siːmz tə bi ðə ˈprɑbləm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I dropped my phone on the sidewalk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ drɑpt maɪ foʊn ɑn ðə ˈsaɪdˌwɔk./
dialogue.zh: 我把手機掉在人行道上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ouch, that always hurts the screen.
dialogue.zh: 哎唷，那樣肯定會傷到螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The glass is cracked in one corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡlæs ɪz krækt ɪn wʌn ˈkɔrnər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is the touch screen still working?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly yes, but part of it feels dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli jɛs, bʌt pɑrt əv ɪt filz dɛd./
dialogue.zh: 大部分可以，但有一塊完全沒反應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That usually means the digitizer is damaged.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈjuʒuəli minz ðə ˈdɪdʒəˌtaɪzər ɪz ˈdæmɪndʒd./
dialogue.zh: 那就代表觸控層受損了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you fix it today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look at it first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, I brought it with the case.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, aɪ brɔt ɪt wɪð ðə keɪs./
dialogue.zh: 給，我是連手機殼一起帶來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I will take the case off.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə keɪs ɔf./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The case hid a longer crack.
dialogue.zh: 殼子把一道長裂縫藏起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this line runs across the display.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɪs laɪn rʌnz əˈkrɔs ðə dɪˈspleɪ./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，這條裂紋橫過了整個顯示區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that change the repair price?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the panel still lights up fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə ˈpænl stɪl laɪts ʌp faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 不會，面板還亮得好好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was hoping for a cheap screen swap.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wəz ˈhoʊpɪŋ fər ə tʃip skrin swɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我原本希望換螢幕便宜一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It depends on which model you have.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪˈpɛndz ɑn wɪtʃ ˈmɑdəl ju hæv./
dialogue.zh: 那要看你是哪一款機型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is the smaller one from two years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə ˈsmɔlər wʌn frʌm tu jɪrz əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 是兩年前買的小尺寸款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the part should be in stock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə pɑrt ʃʊd bi ɪn stɑk./
dialogue.zh: 那螢幕零件應該有現貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I need it for work tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, aɪ nid ɪt fər wɜrk təˈmɑroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我明天上班要用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, I will mark this urgent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need an appointment?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk-ins are fine before five.
dialogue.zh: 五點前直接上門也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the line outside looked long.
dialogue.zh: 還好，外面排隊看起來很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We had two slow repairs this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæd tu sloʊ rɪˈpɛrz ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 今天早上有兩台修得特別久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, it got wet in the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ, ɪt ɡɑt wɛt ɪn ðə reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 還有件事，它在雨裡也淋濕過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did water get into the charging port?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈwɔtər ɡɛt ˈɪntə ðə ˈtʃɑrdʒɪŋ pɔrt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think so, it beeped twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should not charge it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not? The battery is almost empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt? ðə ˈbætəri ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst ˈɛmpi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charging a wet phone can burn the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɑrdʒɪŋ ə wɛt foʊn kæn bɜrn ðə bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 濕的手機充電會燒壞主機板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds expensive to repair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It depends how long the moisture stayed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪˈpɛndz haʊ lɔŋ ðə ˈmɔɪstʃər steɪd./
dialogue.zh: 要看水汽在裡面留了多久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe ten minutes, I dried the outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi tɛn ˈmɪnɪts, aɪ draɪd ðə ˈaʊtsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 大概十分鐘，外面的我有擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you put it in rice?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, my coworker laughed at that idea.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, maɪ ˈkoʊwɜrkər læft æt ðæt aɪˈdiə./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，同事還笑這個偏方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is right, rice does not help much.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz raɪt, raɪs dʌz nɑt hɛlp mʌtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 他說得對，米其實沒什麼用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what should I do now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it off and let us open it.
dialogue.phonetic: /liːv ɪt ɔf ænd lɛt ʌs ˈoʊpən ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 先關機，讓我們打開看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you clean the inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We use a special cleaning bath.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that take all day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually two hours if nothing corroded.
dialogue.zh: 如果沒有腐蝕，大概兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My screen also flickers sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 我的螢幕有時候還會閃爍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it happen when the phone gets warm?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt ˈhæpən wɛn ðə foʊn ɡɛts wɔrm?/
dialogue.zh: 是手機發熱時才會這樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, especially while I play games.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That points to a loose display connector.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pɔɪnts tə ə lus dɪˈspleɪ kəˈnɛktər./
dialogue.zh: 那可能是顯示排線鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can that be fixed with glue?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we reseat the cable inside.
dialogue.zh: 不行，要把裡面的排線重新插好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, you seem to know the problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ju siːm tə noʊ ðə ˈprɑbləm./
dialogue.zh: 好，你好像已經知道問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me anything else you noticed.
dialogue.zh: 還有哪裡不對，一併告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The back cover is shattered too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that glass or plastic?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have no idea, it came with the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv noʊ aɪˈdiə, ɪt keɪm wɪð ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 我不清楚，買手機時就自帶了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The camera looks fine from here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lens ring has a small chip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɛnz rɪŋ hæz ə smɔl tʃɪp./
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭外圈磕掉了一小塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pictures will still come out clear.
dialogue.zh: 拍出來的照片應該不會受影響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? I thought the camera broke.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我還以為鏡頭壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the ring is scratched, not the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə rɪŋ ɪz skrætʃt, nɑt ðə ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 只是外圈刮傷，鏡片沒破。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a relief, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any problem with calls or sound?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: People say my voice sounds far away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl seɪ maɪ vɔɪs saʊndz fɑr əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 別人都說我的聲音聽起來很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The microphone mesh may be clogged.
dialogue.zh: 麥克風的網孔可能堵住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It started right after the fall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dust gets in through the crack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you clear that today as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju klɪr ðæt təˈdeɪ æz wɛl?/
dialogue.zh: 這個也能今天一起處理嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we can do a full check.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi kæn du ə fʊl tʃɛk./
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們幫你做完整檢測。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A full check sounds good to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fʊl tʃɛk saʊndz ɡʊd tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 完整檢測對我來說最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That covers the screen, battery, and ports.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈkʌvərz ðə skrin, ˈbætəri, ænd pɔrts./
dialogue.zh: 會包含螢幕、電池和接口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My battery dies by two in the afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbætəri daɪz baɪ tu ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnun./
dialogue.zh: 我的電池一到下午兩點就沒電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How old is the phone now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost three years, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the battery health is low.
dialogue.zh: 那電池健康度一定很低了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is low battery health dangerous?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can swell and lift the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kæn swɛl ænd lɪft ðə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 電池膨脹會把螢幕頂起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine does sit a little unevenly.
dialogue.zh: 我的這支確實有一點不平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check it under the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ɪt ˈʌndər ðə læmp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it safe to keep using it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt seɪf tə kip ˈjuzɪŋ ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Avoid hot cars and overnight charging.
dialogue.zh: 別放車裡曬，也別整夜充電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, I park outside all day.
dialogue.zh: 記下了，我整天停在室外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That explains the extra heat stress.
dialogue.zh: 那就難怪熱損這麼嚴重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave my phone with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ liːv maɪ foʊn wɪð ju?/
dialogue.zh: 我能把手機留在你這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will write a ticket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please put my email on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can text when it is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn tɛkst wɛn ɪt ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 修好了我們可以發簡訊給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Texting is better, I check that more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛkstɪŋ ɪz ˈbɛtər, aɪ tʃɛk ðæt mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 發簡訊比較好，我常看那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What is the best number for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə bɛst ˈnʌmbər fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 留哪支電話找你最方便？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It ends in double nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, do you have a lock code?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, du ju hæv ə lɑk koʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，你有解鎖密碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but I will write it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt aɪ wɪl raɪt ɪt daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That saves us both some time.
dialogue.zh: 這樣我們兩個都省時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to show my ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə ʃoʊ maɪ ˌaɪˈdi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just for the pickup signature.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my partner comes instead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They can, with the ticket and your name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kæn, wɪð ðə ˈtɪkɪt ænd jɔr neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 可以，帶著維修單報你的名字就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough, I trust this shop.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have been open since last spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv bɪn ˈoʊpən sɪns læst sprɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們從去年春天開業到現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I heard good things from a neighbor.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd ɡʊd θɪŋz frʌm ə ˈneɪbər./
dialogue.zh: 鄰居都說你們做得不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try to be honest about repairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi traɪ tə bi ˈɑnəst əˈbaʊt rɪˈpɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 我們堅持對維修實話實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did the inspection go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen and battery both need replacing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin ænd ˈbætəri boθ nid rɪˈplesɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both at once? That is a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊt æt wʌns? ðæt ɪz ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 兩個一起換？那數目不小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It saves you one round of labor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt seɪvz ju wʌn raʊnd əv ˈleɪbər./
dialogue.zh: 但這樣你只付一次工資。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the total quote?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred forty dollars, tax included.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is more than I expected.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can check a cheaper option.
dialogue.zh: 我可以幫你看看便宜方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, my budget is tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An aftermarket screen costs less.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is wrong with that one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The colors look slightly dimmer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would I notice it right away?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you edit photos a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ju ˈɛdɪt ˈfoʊtoʊz ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 只有常修圖的人才看得出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that one is fine then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, screen and battery both?
dialogue.zh: 所以螢幕和電池都換嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the swelling worried me.
dialogue.zh: 要，膨脹那件事讓我擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The aftermarket screen saves thirty.
dialogue.zh: 副廠螢幕能省三十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that part guaranteed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We give ninety days on parts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What exactly does the warranty cover?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Defects, not new accidents.
dialogue.zh: 只保不良，不保新的意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So another drop is my problem.
dialogue.zh: 也就是說，再摔壞就得自己負責。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, but we can add coverage.
dialogue.zh: 對，不過我們可以加購保障。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that extra coverage worth it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is nine dollars for six months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz naɪn ˈdɑlərz fər sɪks mʌnθs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that cover accidental damage?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one screen claim per term.
dialogue.zh: 會，保期內螢幕能申請一次理賠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will think about that one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, decide at pickup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you use original manufacturer parts?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We stock both genuine and certified ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi stɑk boʊθ ˈdʒɛnjuɪn ænd ˈsɜrtəˌfaɪd wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 正品和認證件我們都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the price difference?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Genuine screens run about thirty more.
dialogue.zh: 正品螢幕大約貴三十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do genuine parts keep my warranty?
dialogue.zh: 用正品就能保住我的保固嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, third party repairs may void it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈθɜrd ˈpɑrti rɪˈpɛrz meɪ vɔɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 會，第三方維修反而可能讓保固失效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is still under Apple care.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz stɪl ˈʌndər ˈæpəl kɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我的手機還在蘋果保固期內。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the authorized channel is safer.
dialogue.zh: 那走官方授權通路比較保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They quoted me double that price.
dialogue.zh: 他們給我的報價是兩倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours is legal but not authorized.
dialogue.zh: 我們合法，但並非授權店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that hurt future support?
dialogue.zh: 這會影響以後的售後嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if they inspect the inside.
dialogue.zh: 只有在他們拆機檢查時才會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you show me the old part?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ʃoʊ mi ði oʊld pɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 換下來的舊件能給我看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we return every replaced piece.
dialogue.zh: 可以，每個舊零件都還給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some shops keep them, we do not.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ʃɑps kip ðɛm, wi du nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 有些店會留下來，我們不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the labor warranty?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty days on the installation itself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the screen goes dark?
dialogue.zh: 如果螢幕後來黑掉了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it back same day, free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a service fee for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈsɜrvəs fi fər ðæt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fee if it is our work.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fi ɪf ɪt ɪz aʊər wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 問題出在我們手藝就不收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I have been charged before.
dialogue.zh: 還好，我以前被收過這種錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which shop did you try first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mall kiosk near the food court.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mɔl ˈkioʊsk nɪr ðə fud kɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 美食街旁邊那個維修櫃位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They rush the connector sometimes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You found a loose cable, right?
dialogue.zh: 你剛說是排線鬆了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus dust near the speaker.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can that cause the crackling noise?
dialogue.zh: 這會讓聲音劈啪作響嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It explains the sound on speaker calls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə saʊnd ɑn ˈspikər kɔlz./
dialogue.zh: 外放通話的雜音就是它造成的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a new speaker?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a cleaning solved it already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, that saves me money.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cleaning is free today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else should I know?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask me about your data first.
dialogue.zh: 你該先問資料怎麼處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my photos disappear?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Screen work keeps your data.
dialogue.zh: 換螢幕不會動到你的資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the battery replacement?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also safe, but backups never hurt.
dialogue.zh: 也安全，但備份一下總沒壞處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I back it up quickly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ bæk ɪt ʌp ˈkwɪkli?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloud backup works over our wifi.
dialogue.zh: 連我們的無線網走雲端就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your wifi is open?
dialogue.zh: 你們的無線網是開放的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the password is on the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈpæswɜrd ɪz ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will start the upload.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It may take twenty minutes today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty? My plan is full already.
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘？我的空間早滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can plug into a laptop instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn plʌɡ ˈɪntə ə ˈlæpˌtɑp ɪnˈstɛd./
dialogue.zh: 你也可以插電腦來備份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have my laptop in the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv maɪ ˈlæpˌtɑp ɪn ðə bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this will go faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell cases here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep a few shock proof ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip ə fjʊ ʃɑk pruf wʌnz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old case failed on the sidewalk.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ oʊld keɪs feɪld ɑn ðə ˈsaɪdˌwɔk./
dialogue.zh: 我的舊殼在人行道上沒撐住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look for a raised lip on the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk fər ə reɪzd lɪp ɑn ðə ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 選螢幕邊緣突出的那種殼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is a raised lip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Edge plastic above the screen surface.
dialogue.zh: 就是殼緣高過螢幕表面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like good protection.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pair it with a tempered glass film.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɛr ɪt wɪð ə ˈtɛmpərd ɡlæs fɪlm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you install the film too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it comes free with the repair.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt kʌmz fri wɪð ðə rɪˈpɛr./
dialogue.zh: 會，這次維修免費幫你貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take one, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me grab your size.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I owe anything today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Payment happens at pickup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take cards?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cards, cash, or phone pay.
dialogue.zh: 卡、現金或手機支付都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, no need for an ATM.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will send a text soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What exactly will that message say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The amount and the pickup time.
dialogue.zh: 上面會寫金額和取件時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I wait, if at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ weɪt, ɪf æt ɔl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are welcome to sit inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a plug for my laptop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə plʌɡ fər maɪ ˈlæpˌtɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 有給我筆電用的插座嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the outlet behind the chair.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I have emails to answer.
dialogue.zh: 剛好，我有幾封郵件要回。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wifi is crowded around noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No problem, I can work offline.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are coffee shops across the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɑr ˈkɔfi ʃɑps əˈkrɔs ðə strit./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stay nearby?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You must be reachable for questions.
dialogue.zh: 有問題時我們要找得到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What kind of questions come up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes a screw strips or a clip breaks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ə skru strɪps ɔr ə klɪp breɪks./
dialogue.zh: 偶爾螺絲滑牙、卡扣斷掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That does not sound relaxing.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來一點都不讓人輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We only call when we need approval.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈoʊnli kɔl wɛn wi nid əˈpruːvəl./
dialogue.zh: 我們只在你點頭時才打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I get your name for the bench?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɪt jɔr neɪm fər ðə bɛntʃ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Daniel, with a Y at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdænjəl, wɪð ə waɪ æt ði ɛnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, ticket number forty two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is it going so far?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back cover came off cleanly.
dialogue.zh: 後蓋很順利地拆下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find more damage?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slight corrosion near the charging port.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that bad news?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, we brushed it clean.
dialogue.zh: 還不算，我們已經刷乾淨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I owe you extra for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ oʊ ju ˈɛkstrə fər ðæt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, cleaning was included.
dialogue.zh: 不用，清潔本來就算在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for being straight with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fər ˈbiɪŋ streɪt wɪð mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honest quotes keep customers coming back.
dialogue.zh: 報價實在，客人才會回頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my battery out now?
dialogue.zh: 我的電池現在拆下來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Popping it out takes care.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that one so hard?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong adhesive holds it down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does heat loosen the glue?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A warm pad, not too hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I would never try this at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈnɛvər traɪ ðɪs æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 我絕對不會自己在家弄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people do, after one video.
dialogue.zh: 很多人看一支影片就敢動手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I watched two videos and gave up.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑtʃt tu ˈvɪdioʊz ænd ɡeɪv ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 我看了兩段影片就放棄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was the smart move.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the new screen match the old one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə nu skrin mætʃ ði oʊld wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 新螢幕跟原本那塊一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True tone may shift a little.
dialogue.zh: 原彩色溫可能有點偏移。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is true tone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It warms the display in indoor light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɔrmz ðə dɪˈspleɪ ɪn ˈɪnˌdʊr laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 它在室內光下讓螢幕偏暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I notice a color change?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely, after a day of use.
dialogue.zh: 基本不會，用一天就習慣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does touch feel the same?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the sensor is new too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My face unlock should still work?
dialogue.zh: 人臉解鎖應該還能用吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We test it before closing up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, I hate typing passwords.
dialogue.zh: 拜託，我討厭一直打密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So does everyone else here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the fingerprint sensor?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your model uses the screen version.
dialogue.zh: 你這款是藏在螢幕裡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that need recalibration?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the module transfers over.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that worried me last night.
dialogue.zh: 還好，我昨晚一直擔心這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worry less, we have done dozens.
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，這類我們做過幾十台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many phones a week here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡一週要修幾支手機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close to eighty, mostly screens.
dialogue.zh: 快八十支，多數是換螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a busy bench.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our second tech starts Monday.
dialogue.zh: 我們的第二位技師週一到崗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you the owner?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am, this shop is mine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains the careful work.
dialogue.zh: 那就難怪做得這麼仔細。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I answer for every repair.
dialogue.zh: 每一台我都得自己負責。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you fix laptops too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keyboards and batteries, nothing deeper.
dialogue.zh: 鍵盤和電池可以，更裡面的就不接了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My laptop fan is loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it Saturday morning.
dialogue.zh: 週六早上帶來給我看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are Saturdays busy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We open at ten, come early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. Is my data still there?
dialogue.zh: 記下了。我的資料還在吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing was wiped, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could not sync the photos.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try turning the phone off first.
dialogue.zh: 先把手機關機再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, it is still off, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we have not powered it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains the failed upload.
dialogue.zh: 那就難怪上傳會失敗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will need the passcode too.
dialogue.zh: 你待會兒也要輸入密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote it on the ticket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, enter it after the boot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cloud backup looks stuck.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It often pauses on low storage.
dialogue.zh: 空間不足時它常常暫停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only have two gigabytes left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Delete old videos first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My daughter filmed everything last month.
dialogue.zh: 上個月我女兒拍了超多影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move them to a drive instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a spare drive?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is one on the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will buy it if it works.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl baɪ ɪt ɪf ɪt wɜrks./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty dollars, formatted already.
dialogue.zh: 二十美元，已經格式化過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a fair price.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plug it into your laptop now.
dialogue.zh: 現在就插到你的筆電上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The progress bar is moving.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it another ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my screen installed yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the frame needs adhesive.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long for the adhesive?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty minutes under the clamp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I watch you work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only from here, the bench is busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli frʌm hɪr, ðə bɛntʃ ɪz ˈbɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 只能在這裡看，台面很忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is ticket forty two ready?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it passed our checks.
dialogue.zh: 好了，它通過了全部檢測。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is great news.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us test it together now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I get my glasses?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen is already on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The brightness looks normal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drag your finger across the corner.
dialogue.zh: 用手指從那個角落劃過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Touch works there now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try scrolling fast through photos.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No lag at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now make a test call.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who should I dial?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call my counter phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hear me clearly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the microphone is fixed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speaker volume is much better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cleaning did the trick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check the camera.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a picture of the lamp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No black spots in it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That confirms the lens is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Face unlock is instant again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We tested it five times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the battery percentage accurate?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It recalibrates over two days.
dialogue.zh: 它會在兩天內自己校正。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the reading may jump?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only near the bottom end.
dialogue.zh: 只會在低電量時小幅跳動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I will watch it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charge to full tonight, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything else I should do?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip fast charging for a week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new battery settles in slowly.
dialogue.zh: 新電池本來就需要慢慢穩定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, no more hotel chargers.
dialogue.zh: 懂了，不再亂用飯店快充。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And keep it away from water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is still a tiny rattle.
dialogue.zh: 不過裡面還是有一點晃響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me listen to that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It only happens when I shake it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊnli ˈhæpənz wɛn aɪ ʃeɪk ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A loose screw would rattle like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lus skru wʊd ˈrætl laɪk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 那像是裡面有螺絲鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you opening it again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No rush at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it, one screw was short.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，有顆螺絲沒鎖到底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a common problem?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rare, but I check twice now.
dialogue.zh: 少見，但以後我會複查兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I appreciate the extra look.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It would have bothered you later.
dialogue.zh: 不然回家你肯定會介意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any marks left on the frame?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A faint line near the edge.
dialogue.zh: 邊角有一道很淺的印子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that spread?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is cosmetic only.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I accept that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is your old screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it worth keeping?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some people take it as proof.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will recycle it, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can handle that for you.
dialogue.zh: 這個我們可以幫你處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the final total?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred twenty nine dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is less than the quote.
dialogue.zh: 這比原先報價少了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen savings covered the drive.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕省下的錢剛好抵掉硬碟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is kind of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You waited patiently all afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 你整個下午都很有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I go to pay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The register by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you offer an invoice?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The receipt prints a serial number.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please email a copy too.
dialogue.zh: 也請寄一份到我的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me the address.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is the one on the ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə wʌn ɑn ðə ˈtɪkɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sent, check your spam folder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your warranty card is in the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈwɔrənti kɑrd ɪz ɪn ðə bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to register it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the date is on the receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə deɪt ɪz ɑn ðə rɪˈsit./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the screen fails next month?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə skrin feɪlz nɛkst mʌnθ?/
dialogue.zh: 如果下個月螢幕出問題呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it in, we replace it free.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt ɪn, wi rɪˈpleɪs ɪt fri./
dialogue.zh: 拿過來，我們免費再換一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: During regular store hours?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any day except Tuesday.
dialogue.zh: 除了週二以外哪天都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is Tuesday closed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is our parts ordering day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will note that down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the receipt and bring it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə rɪˈsit ænd brɪŋ ɪt ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 收據留好，到時一併帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question about protection.
dialogue.zh: 還有一個關於保護的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I am listening.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this film really unbreakable?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No film is, it sacrifices itself.
dialogue.zh: 沒有膜不會碎，它替你挨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Meaning it takes the hit?
dialogue.zh: 也就是說它先扛那一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then you replace the film.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you replace it cheaply later?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars with any repair.
dialogue.zh: 只要搭配維修就收五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will remember that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for your business.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for saving my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a good evening, Daniel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I leave a review?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An honest review really helps.
dialogue.zh: 誠實的評價對我們很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five stars, right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I appreciate that, truly.
